title: 10 Best Ficus Benghalensis Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Ficus benghalensis are teas, decoctions, poultices, tinctures, and mucillages, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the leaves or bark are commonly used to treat respiratory and digestive ailments. Decoctions involve boiling the plant parts to extract potent compounds for internal use. Poultices, created by crushing the leaves and applying them to the skin, are effective for reducing inflammation and healing wounds. Tinctures and mucillages provide concentrated forms of the herb’s healing properties, often used for their soothing and detoxifying effects.
